item.title: Interesting Stuff I've Read Recently
item.description: It feels like every time I open Linkedin, Twitter, Youtube, Medium, etc, I get blasted with articles and videos about cool stuff going on in the world. Unfortunately, I only have so much free time, so in order to maintain my sanity I set aside a select few to actually read in-depth. Additionally, I realized it would be productive for me to take a step back and review what I’ve read once in a while. So here’s a few interesting things I’ve read/watched recently.

item.title: NVIDIA's Jetson Thor Is Impressive
item.description:
Intro

NVIDIA recently released the Jetson Thor, their latest state-of-the-art chip in their Jetson line of products. It’s so impressive that it has awoken me from my slumber long enough to do a brief overview of its capabilities. Following the trend of its predecessors, Jetson Thor is marketed as an entire platform aimed at bringing interactive artificial intelligence into the physical plane.
